name: entity-form
title: Entity form
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Dialog or sheet form for one record, plus confirm-delete, an empty state, and a collapsible section. Submit stays disabled while busy.

meta.descriptionEs: Diálogo o panel para crear y editar, con confirmación al borrar, estado vacío y sección plegable.

examples.title: Alta y edición
examples.description: Guardar conserva la posición. Borrar pide confirmación.

meta.usage:
<EntityForm open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} title="Editar" onSubmit={save} onDelete={remove}>
  <input name="title" />
</EntityForm>

api.name: onSubmit
api.description: Called with the form data. The parent keeps position via keepPosition.

api.name: busy
api.description: Disables submit. Use it while an upload is in flight.

api.name: ConfirmDelete / EmptyState / AdminSection
api.description: Shared confirm, empty, and collapsible section.

docs: Position is not a field. The parent copies the current position onto the draft before save.
